content: The lion waits for no coronation ceremony in the jungle; he rules the forest by his own sovereign valour and strength.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Vikramarjita-sattvasya svayameva mrigendrata (विक्रमार्जितसत्त्वस्य स्वयमेव मृगेन्द्रता) — Hitopadesha
explanation: True authority is not bestowed by paper certificates, political appointments, or external titles. The king of beasts holds no election; his royalty is established through unhesitating courage, presence, and natural nobility. Stop waiting for permission to embody leadership.
practicalInsight: Stop waiting for someone to appoint you or validate your worth. Step up and take quiet, noble ownership of your responsibilities today.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life are you waiting for external permission before stepping into your authentic strength?
